outcome: Lactate levels in maternal and umbilical cord blood
Expression and polarization of lactate transporters MCT1 and MCT4 in placental syncytiotrophoblast (STB)
Lactate ratios of fetal cord arterial to maternal blood
cohort: The study included pregnant women with a diagnosis of obesity and a control group of women with normal BMI, all undergoing Cesarean delivery at term.
finding: Maternal obesity is associated with a significant disruption of polarized lactate transporter MCT4 expression in the placental syncytiotrophoblast, characterized by decreased abundance in the microvillous membrane and increased expression in the basal membrane, leading to reduced fetal-to-maternal lactate transport and lower fetal cord arterial to maternal blood lactate ratios.
